_comment: ARV-149a (from the ARV-151 security review): SHA-256 fingerprints of everything the AMAN emulator publishes over the whole reference day (AmanFeed.Build for every minute 00:00 to 23:59, both border sides: desk sessions, desk interval statistics, e-gate intervals and inbound lane demand, serialised as JSON), on seed 9303 and on seed 2026 (AmanEmulatorGoldenTests). Written 2026-10-10 on the tree with ARV-151, and the same values computed on commit 0668d02, before ARV-151 (which changed the scenario's desk truth and not these figures: the emulator reads only which desks work); a change here is reviewed and the value updated with the human's approval. 2026-11-11 (ARV-279c, approved by the owner): both values changed for the ids alone, whose tag now carries the anchor minute the day is laid on (aman-<seed>-20261003T0000 here), while the figures (sessions, desk intervals, e-gate counts and lane demand) are unchanged, which AmanEmulatorIdsOnlyTests proves against the values of 2026-10-10.
